name: Mohammed Bagayogo
contribution: A scholar from Timbuktu, Songhai Empire.

checks.lead: Mohammed Bagayogo Es Sudane Al Wangari Al Timbukti (1523-1593) was a scholar from Timbuktu, Songhai Empire. Baghayogho originated from among the Juula people, who are a Mande ethnic group composed of merchants and scholars.
